title: WorkLineClaim payload
description: One line of a role's work, as the core-work reader uses it (owner, 2026-10-27: 'yes build the reader'): either one thing the hire will actually do, or one job that shares the role's words but is a different job ('not this work': CRM email campaigns for a CRM platform role). Proposed by the desk from the role's own material; only the lines a person confirmed or typed are used. They order people within a band, never change a rating. Never a personal quality, a requirement such as years or a degree, or a person's name.

kind.description: work: one thing the hire will actually do; not: work that looks like this job to a keyword search but is a different job.

central.description: For a work line: true when it makes this job what it is, as opposed to work any similar job has. Null for a not line.
